playbookOutputs: Lodged C-BRTA Cross-Border Road Transport Permit Application on Cross-Easy Portal
C-BRTA Application Reference & Statutory Permit Fee Payment Voucher
playbookCommonFailures: Vehicle Certificate of Fitness (Roadworthy) expired or expires within the requested permit period
Mechanical horse and trailer(s) not each individually supported by RC1 and Roadworthy certificates
SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN non-compliant on the day of C-BRTA verification

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3) & Certified Director ID (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate and certified director ID.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 and certified director ID.

informationToProvide.label: Vehicle Registration (RC1 / NATIS Logbook), Valid Roadworthy Certificate (COF) & Operator Card (G-Disc)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the vehicle RC1 registration certificate, valid Certificate of Fitness (Roadworthy), and commercial Operator Card (Double Disc) for each vehicle/trailer.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Vehicle RC1 registration certificate, unexpired Roadworthy Certificate (Certificate of Fitness), and commercial Operator Card in the operator name.

informationToProvide.label: Driver Certified Passport & Valid Driver Licence with Professional Driving Permit (PrDP)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the cross-border driver valid passport and driver licence card showing an active PrDP.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid passport and South African/SADC driving licence card showing an unexpired Professional Driving Permit (PrDP).

informationToProvide.label: Cross-Border Freight Consignment Contract / Customer Mandate Letter (or Passenger Timetable & Route Authority)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the cross-border transport contract or customer off-take mandate proving commercial need across the specified SADC borders.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed cross-border transport agreement, customer mandate letter, or passenger route schedule supporting the C-BRTA permit application.

informationToProvide.label: Permit Type (Freight vs Passenger), Permit Duration (Temporary 14-Day / 3-Month / 12-Month), Destination SADC Countries & Border Posts
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Freight or Passenger, permit duration, destination SADC countries (e.g., Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Botswana, Zambia, Namibia), and exact border posts.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN & Cross-Easy Portal Login Details (If Already Registered on C-BRTA Cross-Easy)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your active SARS TCS PIN and, if you already have a C-BRTA Cross-Easy profile, your login username and password.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect vehicle and cross-border route data
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: G-disc, roadworthy, tax PIN, and border posts verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Capture and lodge application on Cross-Easy portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application submitted on C-BRTA portal and reference generated

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver filing proof & C-BRTA fee payment invoice
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation voucher posted to Communication History
